fusions.name: Split Wake
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt along your wake into the first enemy it meets; it deals 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Both Rails Firing
fusions.desc: Looses 2 heavy bolts at once, splayed wide to either side of you; each one deals 14 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Heading
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and moves you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Split Cutwater
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
